title: [Performance][Qwen3.8Next][Attention] Dispatch prefill between FIA+mask and GBSA at 24K logical KV [v0.32.0rc]
body:
## What this PR does

This PR ports the Qwen4Exp FIA + selected-token-mask dispatch and the 24K logical-visible-KV dispatch policy from #20304 onto `vllm-project/vllm-ascend:releases/v0.32.0rc`. The original commit ordering and author attribution are preserved while resolving the release-branch integration against its latest head.

### Dispatch policy

- Pure decode always uses GBSA.
- For each prefill request in pure-prefill or mixed batches:
  - if the cached logical KV prefix at the start of the current chunk is below 24K, the whole chunk uses FIA + selected-token mask;
  - if the cached logical KV prefix is at least 24K, the whole chunk uses GBSA.
- A normal 4K chunk that crosses 24K is kept intact on FIA + mask. The following chunk switches to GBSA.
- Mixed batches are classified per request, and consecutive GBSA rows are coalesced without changing request IDs or output positions.

The threshold is based on request/query-row logical visible KV length, not physical cache allocation or the fixed 4K scheduler capacity.

## Why

This retains FIA behavior for short and medium prefill while routing later long-context chunks to GBSA. Decode remains on GBSA.

## Performance results

### 32K input / 1-token output

This single-request result compares the dispatch strategy before and after the stacked optimization. Input length is 32K, output length is 1 token, and concurrency is 1.

| Metric | Unit | Before (dispatch strategy) | After | Change | Change rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| E2EL | ms | 13476.0 | 10325.2 | -3150.8 | -23.38% |
| TTFT | ms | 13475.8 | 10325.0 | -3150.8 | -23.38% |
| ITL | ms | 0.1 | 0.1 | 0.0 | 0.00% |
| Input Tokens | token | 32820 | 32820 | 0 | 0.00% |
| Output Tokens | token | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0.00% |
| Output Token Throughput | token/s | 0.0742 | 0.0969 | +0.0227 | +30.59% |
| Prefill Token Throughput | token/s | 2435.4699 | 3178.6852 | +743.2153 | +30.52% |
| Input Token Throughput | token/s | 2435.4403 | 3178.6461 | +743.2058 | +30.52% |
| Total Token Throughput | token/s | 2435.5145 | 3178.7429 | +743.2284 | +30.52% |
| Request Throughput | req/s | 0.0742 | 0.0969 | +0.0227 | +30.59% |
| Benchmark Duration | ms | 13476.0029 | 10325.1508 | -3150.8521 | -23.38% |
| Total Requests | count | 1 | 1 | 0 | - |
| Concurrency | - | 1.0 | 1.0 | 0 | - |
| Failed Requests | count | 0 | 0 | 0 | - |

The stacked optimization reduces TTFT and E2EL by **23.38%**, while improving prefill, input, and total token throughput by approximately **30.52%**. No requests failed.
## Validation

- Focused dispatch unit tests: **76 passed**.
- Pure Prefill, pure Decode, mixed-batch, and both sides of the 24K boundary are covered.
- On the `releases/v0.32.0rc` base, 553 focused dispatch/GBSA/QSA tests, `py_compile`, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Single-curl semantic checks completed for 4K, 24K, 24K+1, 28K, 32K, and 64K prompts.
- Candidate functional and performance runs completed at 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 33K, 64K, 126K, and 128K.

## Attribution
